{'text': "Looks pretty interesting. ChatGPT's latest update adds a new Mac integration: it can handle conversations from Apple's Messages app. This feature supports iMessage, SMS, and RCS.", 'translation': '睇落幾有趣。ChatGPT 嘅最新更新加入咗一個新嘅 Mac 整合功能：可以處理 Apple「訊息」app 嘅對話。呢個功能支援 iMessage、SMS 同 RCS。'}

{'text': 'ChatGPT for Mac now has an Apple Messages plugin', 'translation': 'ChatGPT for Mac 現已加入 Apple「訊息」插件'}

{'text': 'The new Apple Messages plugin lets ChatGPT read and search chat histories on Mac, as well as prepare and send messages. OpenAI says this is available across all ChatGPT macOS desktop app tiers, and works with both ChatGPT and Codex.', 'translation': '新嘅 Apple「訊息」插件可以畀 ChatGPT 喺 Mac 上面讀取同搜尋聊天記錄,以及準備同發送訊息。OpenAI 話呢個功能喺 ChatGPT macOS 桌面 app 嘅所有方案都可用,ChatGPT 同 Codex 都支援。'}

{'text': "Given the access involved, naturally raising privacy and control concerns, OpenAI stresses that by default, sending messages requires user approval. Users should think carefully before granting persistent approval. OpenAI's plugin guide details the risks, how to revoke permissions, and a known issue around bypassing approval prompts.", 'translation': '由於涉及存取權限,自然引起私隱同控制權嘅疑慮,所以 OpenAI 強調喺預設設定下,發送訊息必須得到用戶批准。用戶喺授予持久批准權限之前應該審慎考慮。OpenAI 嘅插件指南詳細說明咗相關風險、點樣撤銷權限,以及一個涉及停用批准提示嘅已知問題。'}

{'text': "Here's more from the release notes:", 'translation': '以下係更多嚟自版本說明嘅內容:'}

{'text': 'Meanwhile, OpenAI has detailed how the Messages feature works on its dedicated plugin site:', 'translation': '另一方面,OpenAI 喺佢哋嘅專屬插件網站上詳細解釋咗「訊息」功能嘅運作方式:'}

{'text': 'For now, this only works on Macs with Apple silicon; Intel machines are out of luck.', 'translation': '暫時呢個功能只適用於配備 Apple 晶片嘅 Mac,Intel 機就唔得。'}

{'text': "If you ask ChatGPT to send a message for you, you'll get a confirmation prompt before it goes out. There's also an option to skip that step within a given conversation.", 'translation': '如果你叫 ChatGPT 代你發送訊息,喺發送之前系統會彈出確認提示。亦可以選擇喺個別對話中略過呢個確認步驟。'}

{'text': 'Want to find this new feature in ChatGPT? The link below jumps straight to the Messages plugin in ChatGPT for Mac.', 'translation': '想喺 ChatGPT 入面搵到呢個新功能?以下連結可以直接跳到 Mac 版 ChatGPT 嘅「訊息」插件。'}

{'text': 'Co-editing Sites, shared thread snapshots, and more', 'translation': 'Site 共同編輯、共享執行緒快照等功能'}

{'text': 'While the Messages plugin is the headline new feature for Apple users, the update also brings several other improvements. For example, pinned conversations now stay in sync between the ChatGPT desktop app and iOS, so users can access important chats on both Mac and iPhone.', 'translation': '雖然「訊息」插件係 Apple 用戶嘅焦點新功能,但今次更新仲包括其他多項改進。例如,釘選嘅對話而家可以喺 ChatGPT 桌面 app 同 iOS 之間保持同步,用戶可以將重要嘅對話喺 Mac 同 iPhone 之間隨時取用。'}

{'text': "ChatGPT can now also let users share a read-only snapshot of a local Codex thread. These snapshots won't change as the underlying thread updates.", 'translation': 'ChatGPT 而家亦可以畀用戶分享本地 Codex 執行緒嘅唯讀快照。呢啲快照唔會跟住原本嘅執行緒更新而改變。'}

{'text': 'Links from personal accounts can be opened by anyone with the URL; workspace links are limited to members of that workspace. OpenAI says Codex masks known sensitive patterns, but reminds users to review snapshots themselves, since they may still contain sensitive info.', 'translation': '由個人帳戶產生嘅連結,任何攞到 URL 嘅人都可以開到;而工作空間嘅連結就只限於該工作空間嘅成員。OpenAI 表示 Codex 會遮蓋已知嘅機密格式,但提醒用戶要自己檢查快照,因為當中可能仍然包含敏感資料。'}

{'text': 'Site owners can also now invite existing members of the same workspace to co-edit Sites with collaboration enabled. Editors can update content and database entries, save versions, and publish updates once the owner has done the initial publish. Owners still control access, settings, analytics, and version restore.', 'translation': '此外,Site 嘅擁有者可以邀請同一個工作空間嘅現有成員共同編輯協作功能已啟用嘅 Site。編輯者可以更新內容同資料庫資料、儲存版本,以及�擁有者完成首次發布後發布更新。擁有者仍然掌握存取權限、設定、分析同版本還原嘅控制權。'}

{'text': 'Some Site owners can also change their ChatGPT-hosted URL without redeploying, with old addresses automatically redirecting to the new one.', 'translation': '部分 Site 擁有者亦可以更改 ChatGPT 託管嘅 URL 而毋須重新部署,舊地址會自動跳轉到新地址。'}

{'text': "Finally, last week's Computer Use History feature is rolling out to Pro, Business, and Enterprise users in the European Economic Area, Switzerland, and the UK. The opt-in feature requires Memory to be enabled and is off by default.", 'translation': '最後,上星期推出嘅「電腦使用歷史」功能即將擴展至歐洲經濟區、瑞士同英國嘅 Pro、Business 同 Enterprise 用戶。呢個屬自選性質嘅功能需要開啟「記憶」功能,而且預設係關閉嘅。'}

{'text': 'You can see the full release notes for this update here.', 'translation': '你可以喺呢度睇到今次更新嘅完整版本說明。'}

{'text': 'Get the most out of your Apple products', 'translation': '用盡你 Apple 產品嘅功能'}
